text:
maria: Incident bot just paged PD for inference_error_rate > 5% across us-west-2 GPUs. Seeing a cluster-level spike, routing noise to oncall. @jon can you take a look? :eyes:

incident-bot: ALERT: inference_error_rate (model-serving) crossed threshold (5.2%) @ 2025-07-01T14:12:57Z. PagerDuty: PD-1342. Links: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/1342

jon: looking now. any customer-facing 5xx from the api-gateway?

kevin: checked logs quickly — gateway 5xx ~ flat. Most errors are model runtime timeouts + `kv cache miss` errors from serving nodes. No major spike in user-facing errors in last 15m. link to quickpanel: https://dash/quick/inference/errors?s=now-30m

maria: good call. sounds like internal model-serving flakiness. still worth keeping PD page live for visibility while we triage. I'm going to create a short quiet window and apply a burst dedupe so oncall doesn't get flooded if this propagates.

jon: +1. proposal: group PD alerts by (cluster, model_name, signal_type) and add a 2-min burst rate limit per group. That should collapse the ~200 quick duplicates into a few context-rich pages.

kevin: yep. Also propose lowering sensitivity on the `inference_error_rate` rolling window from 1m->5m to avoid noise from transient GC/connection blips. Draft rule (PromQL-like):

```
sum(rate(inference_errors_total{env="prod"}[5m])) by (cluster,model) / sum(rate(inference_requests_total{env="prod"}[5m])) by (cluster,model) > 0.05
```

And dedupe config for PD grouping keys: `cluster + model + error_class` (drop host id).

sophia: I like that. Add a short-lived dashboard panel showing per-model 5m error rate and rolling QPS so we can see correlation. Can someone add that tile and share?

kevin: adding tile to the incident dashboard now (panel id: 412). Sharing link in a sec.

ops-bot: NOTE: created quiet window (id: qwin-881) for 10 minutes starting 2025-07-01T14:20Z. Temporarily squelching duplicate PD pages for groups matching: `inference_*` signals.

maria: tagging @oncall-rotation to confirm this is ok: we are keeping a watch but reducing PD chatter to one page per model/cluster for now. If customer impact observed, we'll escalate.

jon: quick customer check: ran `SELECT count(*) FROM api_logs WHERE status >= 500 AND ts > now() - interval '30 minutes'` against prod-recent — no uptick. So low customer impact.

kevin: panel link: https://dash/incident/412 — shows confined spike to gpu-pool-6 with short bursts. Looks like a recent canary model rollout touched that pool ~14:05.

maria: ok plan moving forward: (1) short-term: keep quiet window + grouping + 5m evaluation window for 30m; (2) medium-term (postmortem): implement permanent PD grouping keys, add 5m-windowed alert and synthetic model-run monitors, and adjust runbook steps; (3) owners: kevin -> dashboard + grouping PR, jon -> post-incident signal triage + runbook updates, sophia -> customer-impact check and comms.

jon: I'll open the runbook PR and drop a checklist: reproduce locally, validate model rollback path, add synthetic golden prompt monitor.

kevin: creating grouping PR now: https://git.redwood/p/r/9987 — includes dedupe policy and rate limit config. PTAL.

maria: thanks. if no customer-facing errors in next 30m we can resolve PD and close this thread. For the record, this feels like an inference runtime regression introduced by the recent canary. Will follow up in postmortem. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: ALERT RESOLVED: inference_error_rate back below threshold (now 1.1%) @ 2025-07-01T14:44:12Z. PD incident PD-1342 auto-resolved.

maria: closing loop — no customer impact observed, quiet window expired, items assigned. will put the long-term changes on next sprint. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
